xmldoc.short_description: Filter a 3-D volume with a Gaussian kernel.

param_input_item.param_description: Numeric or logical 3-D volume. Complex numeric volumes are filtered by applying the same separable kernel to real and imaginary parts.
Standard deviation of the Gaussian kernel. It can be a positive scalar or a three-element vector. The default value is 0.5.
Odd positive scalar or three-element vector that specifies the kernel size. By default the size is derived from sigma.
Boundary handling mode: 'replicate', 'symmetric', 'circular', or a finite scalar fill value.
Accepted for compatibility. The current implementation uses spatial separable convolution.

param_output_item.param_description: Filtered 3-D volume with the same size as A.

description.p: Filter a numeric or logical 3-D volume with a separable Gaussian kernel. Complex numeric volumes are supported by filtering real and imaginary parts consistently. Sigma can be scalar or a three-element vector. Padding can be replicate, symmetric, circular, or a finite scalar value.
